goals.title: Build a production-quality Metabolic Coach ecosystem for Samsung Gala...
goals.objective: Build a production-quality Metabolic Coach ecosystem for Samsung Galaxy Watch8: modular Kotlin Android companion app, Wear OS touch-first application, custom Wear OS watch face with AOD, shared clean architecture, provider-based CareSens Air CGM and Samsung Health/Health Connect integration research and adapters, battery-efficient phone-watch synchronization, configurable coaching interventions, notifications, daily summaries, personalized non-medical observations, tests, architecture/developer/testing/user documentation, and reproducible phone and watch APKs. Preserve medical-safety boundaries, avoid unsupported integrations, configure every threshold, and verify builds/tests before completion.

goals.title: Adopt Nightscout as the Version 1 glucose source
goals.objective: Refactor the phone glucose subsystem so configurable multi-server Nightscout is the Version 1 primary provider; preserve the provider abstraction, normalized GlucoseReading boundary, coaching engine, Wear Data Layer, notifications, MVVM/Clean Architecture/Repository/Hilt/Flow architecture, and add resilient network/cache/retry behavior, configuration UI, isolated unit tests, and documentation without direct CareSens communication.
goals.evidence: User design decision on 2026-07-24: the stable daily source-of-truth path is CareSens Air app to xDrip+ to Nightscout, and Version 1 must consume Nightscout only.

goals.title: Adopt deferred physical-test governance
goals.objective: Replace the per-milestone blocking physical gate with APOS-approved two-axis engineering/physical status, maintain a privacy-safe cumulative physical-test backlog, preserve foundational stop-review boundaries, and document v0.6.0 as Engineering PASS / Physical DEFERRED without fabricating acceptance.
goals.evidence: User governance update on 2026-08-12 and APOS GO WITH CONDITIONS response in the bound main architecture room.

goals.title: Implement v0.6.1 rapid-rise walk coaching
goals.objective: Implement the APOS-approved engineering-only v0.6.1 rapid-rise walk milestone using two consecutive same-exact-source qualifying normalized readings, deterministic pair identity, post-meal precedence, existing shared safety and global delivery/session semantics, no provider/polling/Wear-protocol/persistence-model changes, full regression/review/package gates, and Physical DEFERRED backlog evidence.
goals.evidence: APOS v0.6.1 architecture gate returned GO WITH CONDITIONS on 2026-08-12.
